verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਠਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pooraa satigur jaaneeaai poore pooraa ThaaT banaiaa|

en.bdb: The perfect true Guru is known in his majestic form.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਵਧੈ ਘਟਾਇ ਵਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: poore pooraa tol hai ghaTai na vadhai ghaTai vadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Perfect is the justice of the perfect Guru to which nothing can be added nor reduced from.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਸੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: poore pooree mat hai horas puchh na mataa pakaiaa|

en.bdb: The wisdom of the perfect Guru is perfect and he makes up his mind with out asking for other's counsel .

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਟਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: poore pooraa ma(n)t hai pooraa bachan na Talai Talaiaa|

en.bdb: The mantra of the perfect is perfect and his command cannot be avoided.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sabhe ichhaa pooreeaa saadhasa(n)gat mil pooraa paiaa|

en.bdb: All desires are fulfilled when joining the holy congregation, one meets the perfect Guru .

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਉੜੀ ਚੜੑਹਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh kai pat pauRee chaR(h)h nij ghar aaiaa|

en.bdb: Crossing all calculations the Guru has climbed the ladder of honour to reach his own loft.
Becoming perfect he has merged in that perfect Lord.
